name: Alice Johnson
biography: Alice is a senior software engineer with 15 years of experience building developer tools and open-source projects. She is passionate about clean code, mentoring, and making complex topics accessible.

name: Bob Smith
biography: Bob is a QA architect who has been writing automated tests since before it was cool. He runs the testing guild at a major tech company and speaks regularly at conferences about quality engineering.

name: Carol Davis
biography: Carol is a DevOps consultant and workshop facilitator who helps teams adopt CI/CD practices. With a background in both development and operations, she bridges the gap between building and shipping software.
